documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our wholesale distribution team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's wholesale distribution team is exploring options but has not identified a specific requirement or project owner. This lack of clarity is creating operational friction, as the customer requests clarification before proceeding with a discovery meeting.

claims.quote: We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your wholesale distribution team is currently exploring options, and you're seeking clarity before moving forward. To help us better support you, could you please share more details about the specific challenges or goals you're addressing? This will allow us to tailor our approach and ensure we align with your needs.
questions: What specific challenges or goals is your wholesale distribution team currently facing?
Are there any particular systems or processes that you're looking to integrate or improve?
Who within your organization would be the primary contact for this initiative?
uncertainties: The lack of a defined requirement or project owner may delay progress.
The customer has not provided enough detail to determine the scope of the potential engagement.
